title: 23-BCV-013/19-EDB-002 — Elevator and passenger-elevating devices
code_edition: National Building Code – 2023 Alberta Edition; Alberta Elevating Devices Codes Regulation

facts.text: The variance applies where a passenger elevator is installed instead of a lift or LULA to satisfy barrier-free requirements.
It limits vertical travel to 7,620 mm or less and requires elevator-car dimensions at least those in Sentence 3.8.3.7.(2).
The source states Firefighters’ Emergency Operation elements are not required in the specified substitution circumstances.
Applicants using the variance are directed to provide copies of a Building Permit and an Elevating Devices Permit to the AHJ.
